purpose: Validate annual national future fertility and mortality profiles that are combined with local calibrated relative shapes in the production forecast.
requiredChecks: production baseline uses raps2024 as default fertility scenario
futureNationalProfileMode explicitly identifies SCB 2024 annual national profiles
all five municipalities have complete annual fertility ages 15-49 for the supported ten-year horizon
all five municipalities have complete annual mortality ages 0-100 by sex for the supported ten-year horizon
all production fertility and mortality values are finite and nonnegative
SCB 2026 fertility sensitivity, when present, covers the same ten-year horizon without replacing mortality or migration assumptions
governance: National future profiles are source assumptions; local calibration remains a separate component.
SCB 2026 is a fertility sensitivity until a separately validated baseline change is approved.
Missing future years must fail validation rather than silently fall back to historical rates within the supported UI horizon.
